{{Quote|Oaka Prime. I loved this place even before I knew it actually existed for real.|[[Seren Song]]|<ref name="SW20" />}}
'''Oaka Prime''' was a wildlife preserve [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SW20" /> in the far corners of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Under the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], Oaka Prime was designated as a nature reserve, kept apart from the conflicts with the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] and the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]], but it fell into obscurity after the [[Rakatan Civil War|collapse of the Empire]]. The nascent [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] later confirmed the planet’s protected status, which was maintained for several tens of thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Many of the species that lived on Oaka Prime were rare or already extinct elsewhere.<ref name="SW20" />

By the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the world was considered a mythical place and served as the setting for many children’s stories. Numerous children also imagined their own adventures on Oaka Prime, among them the future [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Seren Song]] and Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the planet’s orbit served as a meeting point for Organa and Song, where the crew of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] managed to [[Mission to Oaka Prime|rescue]] the agent from the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88B]].<ref name="SW20" />
